A  lot  of  people  don't  know  how  to  price 
 their  upsells.  They  have  one  thing  for 
 $100  and  they  try  and  upsell  a  second 
 thing  for  $120.  That's  not  how  you  want 
 to  do  it.  Customers  tend  to  be  fractal, 
 meaning  that  the  top  20%  has  five  times 
 the  spending  power  of  the  bottom  80.  And 
 so  if  you're  going  to  do  an  upsell,  make 
 the  upsell  five  times  more.  [music]
